bars_path.description: CSV of daily bars (unadjusted OHLCV): security, date, open, high, low, close, volume, optional vwap / adjustment_ref / knowledge_time.

corporate_actions_path.description: Splits/dividends/spinoffs: security, action_type, ex_date, announced_on, optional ratio / amount / record_date / pay_date.

delistings_path.description: Delisting events: security, reason, last_trade_date, announced_on, optional final_value_policy.

session_close_utc.description: When a daily bar becomes knowable, as an ISO time in UTC. Default 21:00.

adjustment_ref.description: Name of the as-of-date adjustment factor set these bars pair with.

data_class.description: Export classification stamped on every row. Defaults to licensed.

source_id.description: Provider id recorded on every observation. Defaults to the adapter id.
